title: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
title_zh: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。

title: Digital Safe Havens: The Economics of Tokenized Treasuries
title_zh: 数字避风港：代币化国债的经济学
authors: Chen Lin, Eswar S. Prasad, Daniel Rabetti, Che Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the emerging market for tokenized US Treasuries and yield-bearing dollar instruments on public blockchains. Using a comprehensive dataset that combines on-chain transactions, protocol-level total value locked, pool yields, and monetary policy and stress events, we document three core findings. First, yields can be decomposed into distinct components reflecting issuer fees, lending premia, leverage, basis-trade carry, and collateral pledgability, with the latter generating economically large implicit convenience yields. Second, monetary policy transmission into on-chain dollar markets is highly heterogeneous across product designs, with administratively set rates adjusting slowly and basis-trade-backed instruments displaying economically amplified responses to policy shocks. Third, tokenized Treasuries serve as digital safe havens during episodes of cross-asset stress, attracting large inflows during risk-off events while simultaneously exposing new fragilities arising from the interaction between on-chain composability and off-chain reserve structures, particularly through stablecoin balance sheets. Overall, we provide insights into the distinctive dynamics of pricing, transmission, and fragility of digital Treasuries as decentralized and traditional financial infrastructures increasingly integrate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了新兴的代币化美国国债及公共区块链上生息美元工具市场。通过整合链上交易、协议级锁定总价值、资金池收益率以及货币政策与压力事件的综合数据集，我们得出三项核心发现。第一，收益率可分解为反映发行人费用、贷款溢价、杠杆、基差交易利差及抵押品可质押性的不同组成部分，其中后者产生了经济意义上显著的隐性便利收益率。第二，货币政策向链上美元市场的传导在不同产品设计间呈现高度异质性：行政设定利率调整缓慢，而基差交易支持的工具对政策冲击表现出经济意义上放大的响应。第三，代币化国债在跨资产压力时期充当数字安全港，在风险规避事件期间吸引大量资金流入，同时暴露出链上可组合性与链下储备结构相互作用所产生的新型脆弱性，尤其是通过稳定币资产负债表。总体而言，随着去中心化与传统金融基础设施日益融合，本文为数字国债在定价、传导及脆弱性方面的独特动态提供了洞见。

title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
title_zh: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病
abstract: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80)
abstract_zh: 如果具有异质性技能的工人自我选择进入不同部门，服务业劳动生产率增长可能被误测。基于美国数据，本文发现：从制造业重新配置到专业服务业的工人，其收入高于该部门原有工人，但低于教育、卫生和公共服务部门的原有工人。一个广义定量罗伊模型预测，专业服务业中由选择效应导致的劳动生产率增长，比传统选择模型的预测值高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业成本病的贡献微乎其微，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80）

title: The Rise and Fall of Input Suppliers
abstract: ABSTRACT This paper presents a model of vertical market structure that integrates multiple determinants previously studied in isolation. It shows how the nature of market growth, whether through existing or new applications of an input, and the type of fixed costs, whether exogenous or endogenous, affect the emergence of external suppliers for the input. The role of such suppliers depends on the input's technological generalizability, its potential for improvement, and the breadth and differentiation among downstream applications. Together, these factors shape whether a vertical market structure persists and can potentially drive multiple transitions between vertical integration and outsourcing.

title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
title_zh: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定
authors: Maximilian Grimm, Òscar Jordà, Moritz Schularick, Alan M Taylor
abstract: Abstract Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.
